name: ACH Processing Company Plugin
author: John Innes

sections.description: For the User our payment method then please follow bellow steps. Step 1:- first of all download plugin. Step 2:- goto wp-content > plugins and add plugin in directory. Step 3:- then goto admin side(www.domainname.com/wp-admin) and follow this step click plugins menu > then find “ACH Processing” plugin and then active plugin. Step 4:- Goto WooCommerce menu and click on setting menu. Step 5:- click payment tab and find and Enable “ACH Processing” payment method. Step 6:- then click on manage button. Step 7:- Then Select you payment mode test mode or live. Step 8:- Then add your API Key, User Name and password. Step 9:- Last and final step save changes. Congratulations Your now able to accept payments through ACH Processing Company.
